Rajasthan Students Protest on Water Tank Over Union Elections

In Jaipur, Rajasthan, student leaders climbed a water tank to protest the reinstatement of student union elections. The demonstration, which began on a water tank, continued for over 12.5 hours. The students issued a warning to the government regarding their demands. The protests are specifically linked to the demand for restoring student union elections.
